title: Grammar claim-verification register (claims.yml)
description: Structural contract for each book’s claims.yml — the two-axis falsifiable-assertion register (verdict_fact × verdict_pedagogy). Enums and required keys are taken verbatim from the documented header comments of the six existing registers (ApteSyntax_1885, BuhlerLeitfaden_1923, KocherginaUchebnik_1998, WhitneyGrammar_1889, ZalizniakKonspekt_2004, ZalizniakOcherk_1978); no invented categories. Rendered output is CLAIMS_VERIFIED.md via scripts/build_claims.py.

work.description: Human label of the source work (author, short title, year).

synthesis.description: Optional free-text synthesis of the book’s presentation principles (rendered into CLAIMS_VERIFIED.md).

entries.description: Verified claim entries. Empty array is legal for a seed that has not yet promoted any harvest candidate.

id.description: Stable claim id within the book (e.g. HK-1, HB-60, APT-31, WH-4, KZ-3, OCH-66).

claim_ru.description: The falsifiable assertion, quoted or paraphrased from the book (Russian or English).

kind.description: Claim kind as documented in each claims.yml header (government is used by syntax-weighted books: Apte, Whitney).

verdict_fact.description: Fact axis: is the assertion true vs corpus + reference grammars. PENDING = harvested, not yet verified. YAML unquoted TRUE/FALSE must be coerced to strings before validation.

verdict_pedagogy.description: Pedagogy axis: is the presentation defensible (ordering, foregrounding, hidden frequency).

falsifiable_as.description: Optional one-line restatement of what would count as a falsifying observation.

sources.description: Optional ground-truth sources (e.g. dcs, whitney, talmud).

number.description: Optional corpus figure or systemic fact that supports the fact-axis verdict.

mg_footnote.description: Optional corpus-frequency apparatus added by M.G. where the book states no number (rendered over the reading site).

methodichka.description: Optional learner-facing methodichka gloss (how to teach / remember the corrected claim).
